about: A reading's at is the place it was read at, so what a reader said of two places is said of two cells, and the reader's lines are counted cell by cell. Every fold parses a value once, and folds each content apart from the others, since no order compares two contents; the classes that stand keep the order their first value came in, so the fold says exactly what it said before, faster.
